evals.prompt: Add a 'Course details' screen to this Flutter app (lib/features/courses/). It shows the course title, a status chip (approved / under review / rejected), a yellow tip box saying 'Upload your certificate within 30 days', and a primary 'Upload certificate' button. The design uses #EEF1FF for the tip box background and 16px padding everywhere.
evals.expected_output: Uses the app's tokens instead of literals (maps #EEF1FF to AppColors.infoSurface, 16 to Spacing.lg); status modelled as enum/sealed and rendered with an exhaustive switch; copy kept out of widget literals; scrollable + SafeArea; no fixed widths; analyze clean.
assertions: No Color(0x...) or bare TextStyle( in new/changed files outside lib/core/design/
Tip box uses AppColors.infoSurface (existing token for #EEF1FF) rather than a new hex
Padding uses Spacing.lg / Spacing tokens rather than literal 16
Course status is an enum or sealed type rendered via switch
Screen body is scrollable (ListView / SingleChildScrollView) and wrapped in SafeArea
flutter analyze reports no issues
Every size in new code is a token (tap target, max width, icon size), not only the 16px padding
The primary CTA guards against a double tap on its async action
No files unrelated to the task are modified

evals.prompt: Build this Figma frame as a Flutter widget `PlanCard` in lib/features/plans/plan_card.dart. Figma inspect values: frame 375px wide, fill #FFFFFF, corner radius 8, auto-layout vertical, padding 24, gap 12. Title: 'Pro plan', 18px Bold, line-height 24px, color #0D0D0D. Body: 'Unlimited lessons and priority support', 14px Regular, line-height 21px, color #4A4A4A. Price badge: fill #3D5AFE, text #FFFFFF 12px, radius 999, padding 4/8, positioned absolute top 16 right 16. Gap between body and button: 18px.
evals.expected_output: Maps hexes to AppColors tokens, radius to Radii.card/pill, gaps/padding to Spacing; converts line-height px to multipliers (24/18≈1.33, 21/14=1.5); drops fixed 375 width; notes the off-scale 18px gap; analyze clean.
assertions: No Color(0x...) literals in plan_card.dart
Uses AppText base/heading copyWith (no bare TextStyle()) for the text
Line heights expressed as multipliers (~1.33 and 1.5), not 24/21
No fixed width of 375 on the card
Off-scale 18px gap is rounded to a Spacing token and called out in the summary
flutter analyze reports no issues
The shared token file is unchanged: no new token added for a value that maps or rounds to an existing one
Text styles derive from existing AppText styles, not new global styles
No files unrelated to the task are modified
No Colors.* Material constants in the new widget
A long title cannot run under the absolutely positioned badge (space reserved or tested)

evals.prompt: Add a 'payments history' feature: fetch a paginated list from GET /payments?cursor=<cursor> (response: {items:[{id, amount_cents, currency, created_at}], next_cursor}), cache it so it shows offline, and show it in a list with pull to refresh and infinite scroll. Include tests. Use a fake API source; no real HTTP needed.
evals.expected_output: Feature-first domain/data/presentation; repository interface in domain; DTO+mapper in data; Result/AppError; cursor pagination state ignoring concurrent loads; cache-then-network; sealed states; lazy list; fake-based tests passing.
assertions: lib/features/payments has domain/, data/ and presentation/ folders
Domain declares an abstract repository interface; domain files import no Flutter/HTTP/JSON packages
Repository returns Result/AppError rather than throwing to presentation
Pagination guards against concurrent load-more calls
Cached data is shown before/without network (cache-then-network or offline-first)
List uses ListView.builder/separated or slivers
Tests use fakes and flutter test passes
Concurrent refreshes share one in-flight request
Load-more is triggered from a scroll listener, not from build(), and does not re-fire in a loop after a failure
A feature does not import another feature's data/ or presentation/

evals.prompt: Our signup form (lib/features/signup/signup_screen.dart) lets users tap 'Create account' twice and it creates two accounts. Also errors show while they're still typing the first character. Fix both and add a test.
evals.expected_output: Real in-flight guard (button disabled and/or early return while submitting), not the pass-through overlay; errors on interaction/submit instead of always; test double-taps and asserts one createAccount call; also handles failures/mounted.
assertions: Submit is guarded while in flight (disabled onPressed and/or early return)
AutovalidateMode.always is no longer used from the first keystroke
A test taps the button twice and asserts createAccount was called once
setState after await is guarded by mounted (or equivalent)
flutter test passes
The leaky IgnorePointer overlay is removed or fixed (root cause)
A test proves two taps in the same frame (no pump between) call the API once
No unrelated behaviour changed (e.g. layout rewrite, email normalisation) without being called out

evals.prompt: Deep link https://example.com/courses/42 should open the course screen, even if the app was killed and the user isn't logged in yet. The app doesn't have routing yet. Set it up (code + whatever native/site config is needed — write the config files/snippets into the project) and tell me how to test it.
evals.expected_output: go_router with :courseId path; central redirect preserving from=; refreshListenable on auth; App Links (intent-filter autoVerify + assetlinks.json) and Universal Links (entitlement + AASA); id validation; adb/simctl test commands for cold and warm start.
assertions: Router defines a /courses/:courseId route (path parameter, not an object)
Auth redirect sends signed-out users to login and preserves the original location (e.g. from=)
Android intent-filter with autoVerify and an assetlinks.json are provided
iOS associated domains entitlement and apple-app-site-association are provided
Course id from the link is validated
Testing instructions include adb and xcrun simctl commands and cover cold start
flutter_deeplinking_enabled meta-data, if present, is inside the <activity> element
Auth has a distinct unknown/restoring state so the link survives session restore
Testing commands are runnable as written (include package/bundle id and the full URL)
Package name and bundle id match across assetlinks.json, AASA and native config
The associated-domains entitlement is in a .entitlements file, not Info.plist
A test drives the cold start: unknown → splash → login → target
The project's Dart/Flutter SDK minimum is not raised without asking
